motivation: FN/CONTROL profiling found density 7/9 vs 0/27, but the control pool holds density structurally constant, so no causal claim is licensed. This probe manipulates density with minimal pairs.

hypothesis.H1: Added propositional structure (relative clause / adverbial clause) around a constant target frame systematically produces candidate failure.
hypothesis.H0: Candidate generation is unaffected by added propositional density given a constant target frame.

conditions.REL: target frame + relative clause on the theme (MULTIPLE_EMBEDDED)
conditions.ADV: target frame + adverbial clause with own subject (MULTIPLE_EMBEDDED)

invariants: same predicate, roles, entity types, target frame; YES=give/provide-class verbs, NO=deny mirrors; no new lexical triggers

decision_rule.density_support: REL/ADV materially below SINGLE with identical frames, reproducing across sets
decision_rule.negative_result: density does not systematically cause failure; profiling separation stays descriptive

profiling_separation: the 36 profiling items stay untouched; this is an independent test, not a re-analysis
material_shape: 4 sets x 3 conditions x YES/NO = 24 sentences
test_material: built by script; validation + freeze below
